sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach's overall form remains strong with seven wins from their last six games prior to that defeat. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who sit bottom of the division with just four points and are winless in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture that could have title-race implications if Sandbach drop points. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a battle between two strong performers—Bridgnorth have won four of their last five, while Eccleshall have just won and are climbing the table. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth, face Wednesfield Community at home in a midweek fixture on Wednesday after Saturday's match against them. The two strugglers, Widnes Town (bottom with 2 points, on a five-game losing run) and Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th with 7 points), face difficult tests at home to Brereton Social and away to Telford Town respectively. Bilston Town's visit to Foley Meir sees two mid-table sides clash, while New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a low-points contest. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-league battle, and Shawbury United, winless in their last five games, host Barnton on Saturday.
